objects.fact: One circular disk with a single sector missing from the upper edge. The remaining material occupies the circular contour except for this upward-opening wedge.
One straight radial boundary runs from the common interior apex toward the upper-left edge.
The second straight radial boundary runs from the same apex toward the upper-right edge.
The wedge between those two radial edges is empty and opens to the outer circumference; it is not a hole enclosed within the disk.
A short curved angle indicator with ends directed toward the two radial edges spans the missing wedge above its apex.
The sole mathematical label is phi, above the angle indicator.
Diagonal hatching fills the remaining disk material, not the missing wedge. It is material fill, not a coordinate grid, scale or measured row/column array.

relationships.fact: The two radial edges meet at one common apex inside the circular contour.
Phi denotes the opening between the two sector boundaries, not an angle of the remaining major disk region.
The single missing sector opens upward through the circular perimeter.

notPresent: No numerical angle, radius, diameter, temperature or dimensional tick.
No center label or separately marked center dot.
No heated-state outline, second panel, expansion arrow or answer about whether phi changes.

objects.fact: One upper open terminal on the left, connected upward to the top circuit wire.
One lower open terminal on the left, connected downward to the heater-side bottom wire.
An alternating-current mark lies between the two left terminals. No battery, voltage number or explicitly drawn power-source body.
The upper terminal wire rises, runs horizontally to the right and descends vertically to a downward-pointing contact above the strip.
A filled downward contact tip meets the upper strip outline from above. It is a switch contact, not an added current-direction or bend-direction arrow.
The upper layer of the horizontal straight double strip is unhatched and has no material or coefficient label.
The lower layer of the same strip has diagonal hatching and no material or coefficient label.
One horizontal interface separates the two touching layers; their left contours align and the strip is straight in the printed view.
The right end is the connected/fixed side of the strip; its wire turns down at the far right and then left toward the heater. No separate wall, clamp or support block is drawn.
One rectangular heater symbol in the bottom return branch carries the printed heater label.
The heater's left side connects to the lower AC terminal through the lower-left wire.

relationships.fact: Continuous upper wire from the upper terminal to the contact above the strip.
The contact is above the free portion to the left of the right-end connection. The printed strip also extends left beyond the contact; do not force the contact onto the geometric extreme left tip.
Two touching horizontal layers form a single straight strip, with an unhatched upper layer and a diagonally hatched lower layer.
The right-side strip connection continues down and left into the heater's right side.
The heater's left side returns to the lower terminal. The heater and strip/contact path are in series, with no parallel heater branch.
